summary.text: Angela Arsenault is a Democratic state representative from the Chittenden-2 District who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Angela Arsenault was born in Burlington, Vermont, and graduated from Randolph Union High School in 1995.
Arsenault earned a B.A. in journalism and sport management from the University of Massachusetts, Amherst, in 1999.
Arsenault's career experience includes working as a journalist for the New York Post, Gotham, and Los Angeles Confidential.
Arsenault became chair of the Champlain Valley School District board of directors and volunteered with the Williston Community Justice Center and the Education Justice Coalition of Vermont.
